data.title: SEO Specialist
data.tldr:
Говорят, что в iGaming не попасть без опыта.
Наша компания готова стать вашим первым местом работы в этой нише.

Ищем SEO-специалистов уровня Junior/Middle c 0 опыта в сфере iGaming.

Основная задача - находить, тестировать и масштабировать SEO-связки, которые приводят не только органический трафик, но и FTD, депозиты и прибыль.

data.title: Performance-маркетолог
data.tldr:
Ищем Junior и Middle маркетологов для работы с рекламой и привлечением пользователей.

Опыт в iGaming НЕ требуется - мы готовы обучить специфике индустрии с нуля.

Важен практический опыт в маркетинге и умение работать с цифрами, гипотезами и рекламными каналами.

data.title: System Analysis Trainee
data.tldr: System Analyst Trainee (System Analysis): A 5-month intensive program focused on software development lifecycle, requirements analysis, and system design with an accent on practical project tasks. Focus on bridging business needs and technical implementation through documentation, API specifications, and process modeling.

data.title: Junior Android Developer (Fintech)
data.tldr: Junior Android Developer (Fintech): Developing features for a mobile banking application with an accent on secure transaction processing and partner integrations. Focus on building scalable UI components using Jetpack Compose and implementing robust financial logic within a professional team environment.

data.title: Business Analyst Trainee
data.tldr: Business Analyst Trainee (Business Analysis): A 5-month intensive program focused on transitioning from theoretical knowledge to practical application in software development with an accent on requirements management and stakeholder communication. Focus on building expertise in business domains like fintech and healthcare while preparing for a full-time role within the company.

data.title: Payments Manager (Fintech)
data.tldr: Менеджер по выплатам (Fintech): обработка платежных операций и контроль работоспособности платежных инструментов с акцентом на криптовалютные транзакции. Фокус на обеспечении бесперебойного движения денег в условиях высокой нагрузки и динамичной среды финтех-стартапа.

data.title: Trainee .NET Developer
data.tldr: Trainee .NET Developer (Backend): Building modern backend solutions and enterprise-level applications with an accent on C# and ASP.NET Core. Focus on mastering OOP, SOLID principles, and relational databases through an intensive 5-month practice-oriented program.

data.title: Finance Operations Specialist (Billing Accountant)
data.tldr: ITea - активно растущая IT-компания, реализующая международные проекты и инновационные IT-решения. Продукты, разработанные, ITea активно применяются крупнейшими мировыми компаниями, лидерами своих индустрий.

data.title: UX/UI Designer (Ad Tech)
data.tldr: UX/UI Designer (Ad Tech): Designing responsive, accessible web and mobile interfaces for multiple client projects with an accent on user research, design systems, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma. Focus on validating design decisions through usability testing, translating complex requirements into intuitive experiences, and using AI tools to improve design workflows.

geo_inference.chip_reason: "option to work from anywhere" and fully remote work

data.title: SW Support Hospitality L2 Aloha Technician (French and English)
data.original_title: SW Support Hospitality L2 Aloha Technician
data.tldr: SW Support Hospitality L2 Aloha Technician (Aloha/POS Support): Providing technical phone and remote support for ALOHA hospitality software, point-of-sale devices, and related products with an accent on incident troubleshooting, customer communication, and timely issue resolution. Focus on analyzing recurring faults, coordinating service dispatches, escalating complex incidents, and maintaining accurate work-order updates.

data.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
data.tldr: Junior DevOps Engineer (Linux/Ansible/Docker/Kubernetes): Supporting and developing infrastructure for a large-scale IT product with an accent on service operations, CI/CD delivery, and routine-task automation. Focus on configuring build pipelines, optimizing operational workflows, and participating in real incidents.

data.title: Product Designer (Fintech)
data.tldr: Product Designer (Fintech): Проектирование цифровых финансовых продуктов для малого и среднего бизнеса с акцентом на структурное продуктовое мышление, понятные пользовательские флоу и проработанные интерфейсы. Focus on end-to-end работе — от discovery до поставки, анализа результатов и итеративного улучшения продукта.

geo_inference.chip_reason: Гибридный формат работы с локациями в Париже, Берлине, Барселоне, Милане и Белграде.

data.title: Software Engineer (Intern, C#)
data.tldr: Software Engineer Intern (C#): Learning and contributing to real backend services and REST APIs for educational platforms with an accent on C# and .NET backend development, database interaction, and clean coding practices. Focus on building learning platform functionality, integrating various services, and participating in the full software development lifecycle within an Agile environment.

data.title: QA Intern
data.tldr: QA Intern (Web/API Testing): Executing manual test cases for web and API-based applications and identifying bugs to ensure software quality. Focus on validating new features, participating in requirement reviews, and improving test documentation under mentorship.

geo_inference.chip_reason: The role explicitly states 100% remote globally.

data.title: Frontend Engineer
data.tldr: Frontend Engineer (Intern): Developing and maintaining responsive and engaging user interfaces using modern web technologies with an accent on efficient and reusable frontend systems. Focus on optimizing web applications for speed and scalability, conducting thorough testing, and participating in code reviews.

geo_inference.chip_reason: The role explicitly states that 100% remote work is available globally.
